news.title: Two arrested in connection with ATM robbery in South Delhi
news.description: Delhi Police arrested two suspects within 24 hours of an ATM robbery in Greater Kailash. The accused were identified through CCTV footage and Rs 2.5 lakh was recovered.

news.title: Heavy fog disrupts flight operations at IGI Airport
news.description: Dense fog conditions led to delays and diversions of over 50 flights at Indira Gandhi International Airport. Visibility dropped to below 50 meters in early morning hours.

news.title: Farmers begin protest march towards Delhi borders
news.description: Thousands of farmers from Punjab and Haryana started marching towards Delhi demanding better MSP for crops. Police have increased security at border checkpoints.

news.title: Minor fire breaks out at Chandni Chowk market, no injuries reported
news.description: A small fire broke out at a cloth shop in Chandni Chowk market due to electrical short circuit. Fire brigade brought the situation under control within an hour.

news.title: Delhi Metro announces new route connecting airport to city center
news.description: DMRC unveiled plans for a new express metro line that will reduce travel time from IGI Airport to Connaught Place to just 20 minutes. Construction begins next month.

news.title: Chain snatching incidents rise in North Delhi areas
news.description: Police report a 15% increase in chain snatching cases in North Delhi localities including Rohini and Pitampura. Residents urged to remain vigilant.

news.title: Air quality remains in 'severe' category across Delhi NCR
news.description: Delhi's AQI crossed 400 mark for the third consecutive day. Authorities have implemented GRAP Stage-III restrictions including ban on construction activities.

news.title: Cultural festival inaugurated at India Gate lawns
news.description: The annual winter cultural festival was inaugurated at India Gate featuring performances from artists across the country. The event will continue for two weeks.

news.title: Local train services disrupted due to technical fault at Dadar
news.description: Central Railway services on the main line were affected for two hours due to a signal failure near Dadar station. Thousands of commuters faced delays during rush hour.

news.title: Three injured in road accident on Western Express Highway
news.description: A speeding car lost control and hit the divider on Western Express Highway near Goregaon. Three occupants sustained minor injuries and were taken to nearby hospital.

news.title: Mumbai Police bust major drug racket, 5 arrested
news.description: The Anti-Narcotics Cell seized drugs worth Rs 15 crore and arrested five people including a foreign national in a raid at Andheri. Investigation is ongoing.

news.title: Heavy rainfall expected in Mumbai over the weekend
news.description: IMD has issued a yellow alert for Mumbai predicting heavy rainfall over the next three days. Citizens advised to avoid unnecessary travel during peak rainfall hours.

news.title: New coastal road stretch opens for public
news.description: The southern stretch of Mumbai's Coastal Road from Marine Drive to Worli was inaugurated. The route is expected to reduce travel time significantly for South Mumbai commuters.

news.title: Pickpocketing gang busted at Churchgate station
news.description: Railway Police arrested a four-member gang involved in pickpocketing at Churchgate and nearby stations. Multiple stolen phones and wallets were recovered.

news.title: Marathon event to promote tourism in Mumbai this Sunday
news.description: The Mumbai Tourism Marathon will be held this Sunday covering iconic landmarks including Gateway of India and Marine Drive. Over 10,000 participants have registered.

news.title: Power outage affects parts of Navi Mumbai for 4 hours
news.description: Several areas in Navi Mumbai experienced power cuts due to maintenance work at the substation. Electricity was restored by evening.

news.title: IT professionals protest against sudden layoffs in Electronic City
news.description: Hundreds of IT employees staged a peaceful protest outside a major tech company's campus in Electronic City following announcement of mass layoffs. Traffic was affected.

news.title: Water supply disrupted in several areas due to pipeline burst
news.description: A major pipeline burst near Koramangala has affected water supply to several localities. BWSSB teams are working to repair the damage. Supply expected to resume by tomorrow.

news.title: Two-wheeler theft gang arrested in Whitefield
news.description: Whitefield Police arrested a gang of four involved in stealing two-wheelers across East Bangalore. Twelve stolen vehicles were recovered from their possession.

news.title: Pleasant weather continues in Bangalore with mild showers
news.description: Bangalore continues to enjoy pleasant weather with temperatures ranging between 18-26°C. Light showers expected in some areas during evening hours.

news.title: New metro line connecting airport inaugurated
news.description: Chief Minister inaugurated the new Namma Metro line connecting Kempegowda International Airport to the city center. Travel time reduced to 45 minutes from 2 hours.

news.title: Food poisoning cases reported from restaurant in Indiranagar
news.description: At least 15 people fell ill after eating at a popular restaurant in Indiranagar. Health officials have sealed the establishment pending investigation.

news.title: Startup ecosystem in Bangalore receives global recognition
news.description: Bangalore has been ranked among the top 10 startup ecosystems globally according to a new report. The city hosts over 40% of India's unicorn startups.

news.title: Traffic congestion worsens near Silk Board junction
news.description: Despite ongoing metro construction, traffic near Silk Board junction continues to be a major concern. Commuters report delays of up to 2 hours during peak time.

news.title: Cyclone alert issued for Tamil Nadu coast
news.description: IMD has issued a cyclone warning for the Tamil Nadu coast including Chennai. The depression in Bay of Bengal is expected to intensify. Fishermen advised not to venture into sea.

news.title: Heavy waterlogging reported in Chennai suburbs after overnight rain
news.description: Several low-lying areas in Chennai suburbs including Velachery and Tambaram experienced waterlogging following heavy overnight rainfall. Civic workers deployed for drainage.

news.title: Marina Beach cleaning drive gets massive public participation
news.description: Over 5,000 volunteers participated in the Marina Beach cleanup drive organized by environmental groups. Around 3 tons of plastic waste was collected.

news.title: Robbery at jewelry store in T Nagar, police launch manhunt
news.description: Armed robbers looted gold jewelry worth Rs 50 lakh from a store in T Nagar. CCTV footage shows three masked men entering the store. Investigation underway.

news.title: Chennai airport to get new international terminal by 2026
news.description: The expansion of Chennai International Airport is on track with the new terminal expected to be operational by 2026. Capacity will increase to handle 35 million passengers.

news.title: Auto rickshaw strike affects commuters across Chennai
news.description: Auto rickshaw drivers went on a day-long strike demanding revision of fare structure. Commuters faced difficulties reaching workplaces and stations.

news.title: Famous Mylapore temple festival begins with grand procession
news.description: The annual Panguni festival at Kapaleeshwarar Temple began with a grand chariot procession. Thousands of devotees participated in the religious celebration.

news.title: Minor tremor felt in parts of Chennai, no damage reported
news.description: Residents in some parts of Chennai reported feeling a mild tremor early morning. Seismologists recorded it at 3.2 magnitude. No damage or injuries reported.

news.title: IT corridor sees surge in office space demand
news.description: Hyderabad's IT corridor HITEC City has witnessed a 30% increase in office space demand this quarter. Several global companies are expanding their presence in the city.

news.title: Woman harassed on city bus, accused arrested within hours
news.description: Hyderabad Police arrested a man within three hours of receiving a complaint of harassment on a city bus. The swift action was praised by women's groups.

news.title: Sudden hailstorm surprises residents in old city areas
news.description: Parts of Hyderabad's old city experienced an unexpected hailstorm lasting about 15 minutes. Minor damage to vehicles and crops in surrounding areas reported.

news.title: Traffic diversions announced for G20 delegates visit
news.description: Hyderabad Traffic Police announced temporary diversions in Banjara Hills and Jubilee Hills areas for the visit of G20 delegates. Commuters advised to plan accordingly.

news.title: New flyover inaugurated to ease traffic at Paradise junction
news.description: The long-awaited flyover at Paradise junction was opened to traffic. The structure is expected to ease congestion at one of the busiest intersections in the city.

news.title: Fire breaks out at chemical factory in outskirts, 2 injured
news.description: A fire broke out at a chemical manufacturing unit in Jeedimetla industrial area. Two workers sustained burn injuries. Fire services brought the blaze under control.

news.title: Hyderabad Metro records highest single-day ridership
news.description: Hyderabad Metro Rail recorded its highest ever single-day ridership of 5.5 lakh passengers on Sunday. Officials attribute this to weekend shopping and events.

news.title: Heritage walk through old Hyderabad gains popularity among tourists
news.description: The guided heritage walk covering Charminar, Mecca Masjid, and Laad Bazaar is attracting tourists from across the globe. Bookings have increased by 50% this month.
